notes: V10.0.16 adds Custom Map SAFE ENTRY and FARM RETURN on top of V10.0.15. SAFE ENTRY routes to the climb point, performs UP + Jump, then verifies SAFE before MiuMiu. FARM RETURN routes back to the drop point and performs DOWN + Jump before farming resumes. The feature is isolated to V10 Custom Map profiles; bundled/original map profiles and protected Spotify core files remain unchanged.
